listings.caption: This code computes accuracy on the full training, validation, and test loaders with `calc_accuracy_loader` and prints the three percentages.
listings.code:
train_accuracy = calc_accuracy_loader(train_loader, model, device)
val_accuracy = calc_accuracy_loader(val_loader, model, device)
test_accuracy = calc_accuracy_loader(test_loader, model, device)

print(f"Training accuracy: {train_accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_accuracy*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Test accuracy: {test_accuracy*100:.2f}%")
listings.reason: The code calls the accuracy function with the training, validation, and test data loaders along with the model and device, then prints each accuracy as a percentage. This directly demonstrates measuring performance on all three sets, and the caption accurately describes what the code does (aside from using the abbreviated name `calc_accuracy_loader` vs. `calculate_accuracy_loader`).
